description: Multi-objective RF chain comparison: designs the primary chain with the convergent orchestrator, generates alternative chains by swapping components, scores every variant on cost / size / performance / DC power, and returns the ranked list with a Pareto frontier — the same engine as the Guided 'Compare Alternatives' panel (POST /api/rf-chain/design-multi). Call with no arguments after a chain design to compare that design.

application.description: Application context (e.g. satcom_c_band, wifi_wlan). Derived from the frequency band when omitted.

frequency.description: Operating frequency in GHz. Omit to reuse the conversation's designed chain.

target_output_power.description: Target output power in dBm. Omit to reuse the conversation's designed chain.

user_request.description: The end user's own words that prompted this call, verbatim. Used to verify that the figures you pass were stated by your user rather than inferred. Omit it and the results will be labelled caller-asserted.

weights.description: Objective weights {cost, size, performance, power}, each 0-1; normalized to sum 1.0. Defaults to balanced.

name: compare_rf_chains
title: Compare transmit chain alternatives
